findings.criterion: 1 — resident can share a usable QR pass
findings.issue: Executed React coverage reaches only the no-Web-Share download branch. Neither navigator.share branch, the public /pass route, rendered QR decoding, nor lookup/redeem was executed; the iteration record explicitly says the full-stack path was not run.
findings.consequence: The required resident-to-guest share workflow remains unverified where Web Share, routing, QR rendering, camera decoding, and redemption interact.
findings.correction: Add rendered file-share and text-share payload coverage, then run a mobile browser story that opens the emitted fragment URL unauthenticated, decodes/scans its QR, and completes lookup and redemption.

findings.criterion: 2 plus accessibility — pass scan prepopulates a verifiable check-in and submits safely
findings.issue: The new regression is a hand-built state-machine harness, not an execution of CheckInCapture/CheckInConfirm. No rendered path verifies visible plate prepopulation, focus/live announcement, edit/remove/replace, persisted rejection after navigation, blocked walk-in submission, or the final /v1/passes/redeem payload.
findings.consequence: The acceptance-critical scan-to-prepopulated-form-to-verified-redemption workflow and the iteration-six safety behavior remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: Mount the real routed screens with deferred API responses or add a Playwright story covering hinted/no-hint passes, focus, editing, the QR/plate rejection race, no /v1/sessions request before acknowledgment, and redemption with the intended token and edited plate.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — camera scanning fills check-in and checkout plate fields
findings.issue: The existing 390x844 fake-camera check-in story was not run, and no fake-camera checkout story exists. Unit ALPR tests do not execute getUserMedia, model decoding, React callbacks, controlled fields, route transitions, or checkout matching.
findings.consequence: Both camera acceptance criteria remain unverified in the real responsive UI, with no end-to-end camera evidence for checkout.
findings.correction: Run and record the existing fake-camera check-in story; add and run checkout coverage that opens a known session, scans its plate, verifies the visible field and correct match without manual input, and records browser, viewport, fixture/model, and console result.

findings.criterion: 5 plus authorization/UX — configurable overstay policy editor
findings.issue: The pure role-predicate test does not render GuestPasses or verify that supervisor controls are disabled and no PATCH occurs. No browser test changes the amount as an administrator, saves, reloads, and observes the persisted per-tenant value.
findings.consequence: The required editable policy path and corrected supervisor UX are not established end to end.
findings.correction: Add and run rendered/browser coverage for administrator save/reload persistence and for supervisor read-only controls, absent Save, and no PATCH /v1/pass-policy attempt.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 plus responsive authorization — Admin CRUD and Super Admin cross-property operations
findings.issue: The relevant browser stories were explicitly not run. Current CRUD coverage is desktop-only; the Super Admin story switches property without mutating entities there, and no rendered story proves a regular administrator is denied the second property's reads and writes.
findings.consequence: User-facing CRUD completeness, mobile usability, cross-property Super Admin mutation, and the regular-admin property boundary remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: Run the existing stories; add representative person/site/unit/slot CRUD at a narrow mobile viewport, mutate representative entities after a Super Admin switches property, and assert a regular administrator cannot read or mutate that property's entities.
